description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
 Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advise on target\-state Atlassian Cloud architecture: site and plan topology, sandbox strategy, data residency posture, identity and access patterns (SSO/SCIM, Atlassian Guard), and permission/governance models.
* Lead rationalization recommendations ahead of each wave: workflows, custom fields, schemes, screens, dashboards, and Confluence space structures — reducing migration payload and post\-migration debt.
* Own the Marketplace app gap analysis: Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
* Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.
* Support wave criteria definition and per\-project complexity assessment; contribute to go/no\-go readiness reviews.
* Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
* Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
* Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
* Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
* Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
* Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.


**Preferred**
* Atlassian certifications (e.g., ACP\-level Jira administration).
* Experience in regulated industries where validation evidence and auditability matter.
* Exposure to SAFe\-aligned Jira configuration at scale.

 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Project Architect
description:
**Company Description** 
 Green Home Properties is a multidisciplinary real estate, architectural, interior design, and engineering firm focused on delivering end\-to\-end solutions for housing and development projects. The company provides engineering services, executes real estate projects, and offers advisory support to clients across the property sector. With specialist expertise in structuring real estate transactions, Green Home Properties covers the full development lifecycle from concept and design through positioning and asset disposition. The team brings together experienced real estate professionals who focus on creating, improving, and repositioning assets for optimal value. Services include site identification and acquisition, best use evaluation, concept development, planning and building approvals, pre\-construction management, strategic real estate planning, and tailored sales and off\-take models.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Architect role at Green Home Properties is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. The Project Architect will lead architectural design and documentation for residential and mixed\-use projects, translating client requirements into functional and sustainable design solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include developing concepts and detailed drawings, coordinating Building Information Modeling (BIM) models, preparing and reviewing submittals, and ensuring designs comply with local codes and regulatory standards. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams, consultants, and contractors, overseeing design intent through all project phases from schematic design to construction administration. The Project Architect will also support LEED and other sustainability objectives, participate in client presentations, and help manage schedules and deliverables to keep projects on time and within scope.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong architectural design and technical skills, with proficiency in Architecture fundamentals and building systems.
* Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and workflows for design coordination and documentation.
* Ability to manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables, demonstrating solid Project Management capabilities.
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks such as Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) and interest in green building practices.
* Experience preparing, reviewing, and coordinating Submittals and construction documents with consultants and contractors.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp) and familiarity with local building codes and regulations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited institution; professional licensure or progress toward licensure is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Experience in real estate development or interior design coordination is beneficial.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Manager in EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will manage the development and delivery of tools and platform solutions, blending technical expertise with delivery. The solutions will be focused on improving application performance, engineers’ productivity and automation. You will oversee the identification, development and operationalization of tools, and automation solutions, and ensuring alignment with EY’s quality standards and client expectations. This role requires a manager with experience in implementing platforms and tools in digital engineering engagements, with a balance of hands\-on technical capability and management skills.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Drive the identification of opportunities, development and management of tools and platform capabilities to serve operations engineers, reducing toil and increasing productivity.
* Create self\-service platforms that enable operations engineer autonomy and golden paths.
* Design, implement, and optimize dashboards, logs, and alerting systems using tools like Splunk, AppDynamics, Datadog etc.,
* Manage observability for cloud\-native workloads (AWS/Azure) and hybrid environments.
* Drive automation using cloud, monitoring, and SDLC tools to integrate observability into CI/CD pipelines and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Bring together Cloud, AI/ML platforms, automation technologies, DevSecOps, ITSM, and observability into a coherent, supportable managed services ecosystem. Architect and integrate end‑to‑end tool chains spanning across different tools across layers such as:
+ Cloud \& DevSecOps: Azure (preferred), AWS, GCP; Kubernetes; Terraform; GitHub/Azure DevOps; GitOps
+ Data \& AI: Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Snowflake, vector databases, MLOps pipelines, prompt/version management
+ Automation: UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Automation, event‑driven workflows
+ ITSM \& AIOps: ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana
+ Security: Entra ID, Key Vault, Sentinel/Splunk, DLP and data governance tools

* Monitor production performance (SLAs/KPIs) and drive incident resolution, including on\-call management.
* Maintains scalable, secure, and resilient engineering / cloud application architecture while managing day\-to\-day operations.
* Define SLAs, SLOs, OLAs, service catalogs, and automation backlogs.
* Guide service onboarding, knowledge transfer (KCS), runbook creation, and CMDB population.
* Drive increased automation coverage and reduced MTTR through self‑healing and AIOps patterns.
* Mentor and develop junior engineers on site reliability engineering (SRE) principles.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams – data engineers, Engineering teams, developers, AI / Automation team, architects, and business stakeholders to identify, and drive transformation.
* Ensure compliance with EY’s risk management and security standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience in public cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), DevOps, and automation tools
* Strong skills in programming/scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for custom automation.
* Deep understanding of SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing, and log management.
* Experience building and implementing tools, automation and AI solutions in digital engineering.
* Strong track record in managing delivery quality, project execution, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong understanding and management of ITSM, ITIL methodologies, product engineering, and agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10\-12\+ years of experience in engineering delivery, or managed services, with at least 2\-5 years in developing, implementing and managing engineering platforms, and tools.
* Expert knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (E.g., Datadog / Splunk / Dynatrace / App dynamics / New Relic etc.,)


**What we look for:**
* Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), DevOps, and automation tools and Strong skills in programming/scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
* Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.
* Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
* Detail\-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

 12\-15 years \|

The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Manager SAP SAC Planning / EPM Consultant to lead end‑to‑end planning implementations and drive finance transformation initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, client‑facing EPM engagements, leveraging SAP SAC, BPC, and emerging AI capabilities such as SAP Joule.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**SAP SAC Planning – Implementation \& Delivery**
* A minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions.
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, including requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Design and build SAC Planning Models and Dimensions, including public and private dimensions with attributes and hierarchies.
* Develop Data Actions, Multi\-Actions, and Allocation processes to support driver\-based planning and automation.
* Configure planning workflows, version management, and data locking to enable governed planning cycles.
* Design and develop SAC Stories, Unified Stories, and Digital Boardrooms for executive and operational reporting.
* Build Optimized stories with advanced scripting to support complex planning and analysis use cases.
* Expertise in SAC security configuration.


**SAP Datasphere/HANA Modelling**
* Leverage 2–3 years of hands\-on SAP HANA Modelling experience or Datasphere and SAP BW experience in implementation.
* Design and develop SAP HANA Calculation Views to support SAC Planning and Reporting use cases.
* Perform data modelling, transformations, and performance optimization in SAP Datasphere.
* Collaborate with SAC planning teams to ensure optimal data structures and model performance.


**Soft Skills \& Competencies**
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey ideas in both technical and business friendly language
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
* Highly process oriented with a structured approach to solution design
* Ability to work independently and lead complex engagements
* Strong documentation and knowledge sharing mindset


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in BW
* Good understanding on SAP BDC, Datasphere Seamless planning and SAP Joule and AI.


**\<\< What we look for\>\>**
* Experience working on large scale finance transformation or planning initiatives
* Exposure to competitor EPM tools is a plus
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability building
* Expertise in delivering the process definition document post workshops. Preparing the system design document by mapping client requirements. Capable to work with the team on sprint planning for the delivery.
